newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom to add two cable channel.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom to add two cable channel.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG, operator of Germany's only nationwide cable television network, plans to add two cable channels to the existing 31 to make room for more broadcasters, chairman Ron Sommer said late on Tuesday.
The association of private broadcasters, however, continued to chafe under Telekom's restrictions, and criticised Telekom for its limited plan to expand its cable services.
Sommer told a cable television conference Telekom plans to add the new channels for conventional analog broadcast by the end of 1998.
He said Telekom would also raise its cable rates slightly, and was prepared to invest hundreds of millions of marks to expand the cable network.
Sommer said conference participants had agreed on basic goals, but must still clarify details.

Juergen Doetz, president of the VPRT private broadcasters' association, said the conference had failed to clarify a single open issue. The two new planned channels are only a "bypass", and Telekom still refused to make its investment plans concrete, he said.
